body: ARENA FLASH TEST - DASHBOARD LOAD. Date: 2026-02-22. TEST: Does index.html flash wrong theme on load if mcm-arena-mode=on in localStorage? FINDINGS: index.html line 327 has inline script that runs before DOM: if(localStorage.getItem('mcm-arena-mode')==='on')document.body.classList.add('arena-mode'). This runs synchronously in head, before CSS renders. So no flash - the class is added before paint. BUT: the arena-mode CSS variables in body.arena-mode only affect shared CSS custom properties. The FD dashboard uses --fd-* tokens. So even with arena-mode class on body, the FD dashboard renders in its own dark theme. RESULT: No visual flash. arena-mode body class has no effect on FD dashboard visually. RESIDUAL ISSUE: If someone has mcm-arena-mode=on from old exam session, the body.arena-mode class is set on dashboard load. This class does nothing visible on dashboard but adds noise to DOM. FD confirmed toggle is hidden intentionally. RECOMMENDATION: On dashboard load, if page is index.html, clear mcm-arena-mode from localStorage to prevent stale state. This is a 1-line fix. Spec: in index.html init (before DOMContentLoaded), add: localStorage.removeItem('mcm-arena-mode'). Arena mode only applies to exam pages. Dashboard is always FD dark design. WCAG IMPACT: None. No visual changes. SEVERITY: Low. Cosmetic / state cleanup only.
